task.name: pick_tape_thread_marker
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the tape and thread the tape's central hole through the upright marker on the table.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the tape.
3. Move the right arm to align the tape's central hole with the upright marker.
4. Lower the right arm to thread the tape's central hole through the upright marker.
5. Release the gripper to leave the tape on the marker.
